user.title: Connect a Tuya robot vacuum history
user.description: Select the existing cloud account, vacuum, and optional setting entities used to reconstruct each archived cleaning.

data_description.cloud_entry_id: The LocalTuya entry containing the Tuya Cloud client ID and secret.
data_description.vacuum_entry_id: The Tuya Local entry containing the robot device ID.
data_description.clean_mode_entity_id: Optional Recorder source for dry, wet, or combined mode.
data_description.suction_entity_id: Optional Recorder source for the suction setting.
data_description.water_entity_id: Optional Recorder source for the water-flow setting.

error.invalid_cloud_entry: The selected entry does not contain Tuya Cloud credentials.
error.invalid_vacuum_entry: The selected entry does not contain a Tuya device ID.

abort.already_configured: This vacuum history is already configured.
abort.invalid_cloud_entry: The imported cloud entry is missing or invalid.
abort.invalid_vacuum_entry: The imported vacuum entry is missing or invalid.
